paper_found.authors: B. Ragozzine, D. Clowe, M. Markevitch, A. H. Gonzalez, M. Bradac
paper_found.title: Weak Lensing Results of the Merging Cluster A1758
paper_found.journal_ref: ApJ 744, 94 (2012); DOI 10.1088/0004-637X/744/2/94 (DOI confirmed on arXiv abs page)
paper_found.journal_ref_match: Journal reference matches. BUT the paper has only ONE table (Table 1, 'Mass', aperture masses/luminosities/M/L). There is NO Table 2 in either the arXiv v2 source or the published IOP HTML version (only table id apj413920t1 exists). No table or text in the paper gives RA/Dec coordinates of any lensing peak, X-ray peak or BCG.

subcluster_designated: NW cluster of A1758N = weak-lensing 'Peak 2' (Sect. 4: 'The BCGs of both the SE and NW clusters line up well with the weak lensing peaks in our analysis, which are labeled Peak 1 and Peak 2, respectively.')

z_cl.location: Sect. 1 (Introduction), last paragraph before Sect. 1 ends; also Fig. 1 caption
z_cl.quote: There is very little redshift information for A1758 ($z=0.279$).

I.location: Sect. 4 (Results of A1758), first paragraph; Fig. 1 caption
I.quote: The BCGs of both the SE and NW clusters line up well with the weak lensing peaks in our analysis, which are labeled Peak 1 and Peak 2, respectively. | Fig.1 caption: "The NW cluster's BCG aligns with the X-ray gas and the weak lensing peak."
I.uncertainty_notes: Only shown graphically: Sect. 4.2 'The results are the green and red contours, which show one, two, and three standard deviations of the centroids of Peaks 1 and 2' (Fig. 1 lower-right panel; not readable as a number). Systematic (not 1-sigma): 'If left uncorrected, the mass reconstruction based solely on the stellar shear field at Peak 1 (2) would shift the centroid by a maximum amount of $2\arcsec$ ($6\arcsec$). This is a smaller shift than the 68\% contour levels in Figure 1.' -> so the 68% contour for Peak 2 is stated to be larger than 6 arcsec, but no value given.

notes: No numerical positions or offsets for any of I, G, S are reported anywhere in this paper; all statements are qualitative ('aligns', 'line up well', 'overlays'). The requested 'Table 2' does not exist (paper has only Table 1 = aperture masses centred on kappa peaks, no coordinates). Astrometric accuracy statements (not object centroid errors): Sect. 2.1 'Our mapping to the USNO catalogs was accurate to $0\farcs43$ (median)'; Sect. 2.2 HST WFPC2 'final mosaic has a mean internal astrometric uncertainty of $0\farcs021$'. Kappa-to-BCG separation of the two BCGs: Fig.1 caption 'the two BCGs are separated by $\sim 3\arcmin$ (800 kpc)'. Under the protocol this source cannot supply d_IG or d_IS for the NW subcluster -> unclassifiable from this source alone.
